t: Woken by something he had been shown
a: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، مَاذَا أُنْزِلَ مِنَ الْخَزَائِنِ وَمَاذَا أُنْزِلَ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ
m: Glory be to Allah. What treasures have been sent down tonight, and what tribulations have been sent down. Who will wake the occupants of these rooms to pray? Many a clothed woman in this world will be naked in the Hereafter.
